logline: Catherine enters the wet cells armed with a red-hot iron and Juliana's late mother's botanical book, subjecting the chained heiress to ruthless psychological torment until Juliana's unyielding pride pushes Catherine to a violent brink.
continuity_notes: Follows directly from Episode 30 where Rupert and Catherine plotted to frame Juliana as a witch while Juliana huddled chained in the subterranean dungeon.

scenes.heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

blocks.text: Static medium shot of the heavy, iron-studded dungeon door as the massive bolt loudly slides open.
Heavy iron latch sliding back with an ominous, echoing metallic clang, followed by the deep groaning creak of the cell door swinging inward.
Medium close-up of Juliana huddled against the stone wall, bound in heavy iron chains, shivering in her torn apron and lifting her tear-streaked face in dread.
Juliana recoils against the damp stonework, her eyes wide with terror as light floods into the dark cell.

Full shot framed through the arched doorway. Catherine stands imperiously in an ornate, gold-embroidered violet gown, holding a smoldering hot poker and a charred leather-bound book, flanked by two stone-faced guards with lanterns.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "Look at you."
Low-angle close-up of Juliana looking up from the stone floor, her gaze hardening despite her fear.
Tight close-up of Catherine's face, bathed in the orange flickering glow of the red-hot branding iron, smiling with pure malice.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "The great Lady Juliana Ashcroft."
Over-the-shoulder wide shot past Catherine looking down at Juliana shackled helplessly on the wet stone floor.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "Chained in a dungeon like a common criminal."
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glistening with unshed tears, speaking with quiet defiance.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "You seem very pleased."
Low-angle shot looking up at Catherine towering over Juliana, holding the glowing poker at her side.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "I am."
Extreme close-up of the bent, white-hot tip of the poker radiating heat, with Catherine's face blurred in the background as she gazes down with predatory pleasure.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "Because this is what you were always meant to be."
Over-the-shoulder medium shot focusing on Juliana as Catherine presents the charred, singed pages of the botanical book.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "Your family dressed you like a lady. They educated you. They gave you a respectable name."
Close-up of Catherine's face breaking into an arrogant, haughty laugh.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "[chuckles] And still you became a disgrace."
Tight close-up of Juliana's fierce, unwavering gaze as she retorts without hesitation.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "I became a disgrace when I refused to become cruel."
Close-up of Catherine scowling, cutting back to a shot of Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron manacles against the cold stone floor.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "No. You became a disgrace when Gerald left you standing at the altar."
Medium shot from floor level looking up at Catherine leaning closer, savoring Juliana's humiliation.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "Do you remember?"
Juliana stares up, her breathing steadying as she refuses to break under Catherine's barbs.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "Everyone saw you. Everyone watched him chose Clarisse."
Close-up of the red-hot iron hovering over the damp stone floor, rising steam and heat waves warping the air, before cutting to Catherine's gloating expression.
Faint sizzling and hissing as ambient moisture touches the scalding iron tip.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "And everyone watched you walk away alone."
Close-up pushing in on Juliana's illuminated, dignified face.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "Gerald chose money."

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "Clarissa chose a coward."

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "I chose myself."
Close-up of Catherine's face tightening in disgust.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "You chose a beggar."
Low-angle shot of Juliana lifting her chin with unwavering pride.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "I chose a man."
Medium shot of Catherine sneering down at her.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "A scarred nobody."
Medium shot of Juliana sitting erect against the dungeon wall, her hands resting calmly in her lap.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "A man with more honor than the people sitting above this dungeon."
Medium close-up of Catherine, holding the smoldering iron between them.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "You call that marriage?"
Extreme close-up of Juliana's clear blue eyes, shining with profound conviction.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "I call it love."
High-angle wide shot looking straight down through the ceiling iron grating into the deep dungeon shaft where Catherine looms over Juliana.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "[laughs] Love? Look where your precious love brought you."
Medium close-up of Juliana looking directly up past the glowing tip of the iron poker into Catherine's eyes.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "To a place where I can still look you in the eyes."
Close-up of Catherine, her lips curling in indignant disbelief.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "You think love makes you better than me?"
Close-up of Juliana speaking calmly and razor-sharp.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "No. But cruelty certainly doesn't make you better than me."
Medium shot of Catherine sweeping her arm out, flaunting her aristocratic privilege and opulence.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "I have beauty, money, family, status! What do you have?"
Close-up of Juliana, her expression serene and grounded in moral superiority.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "Knowledge. Love. And people who need me."
Tight shot of Catherine's gloved hands holding Juliana's mother's partially burned botanical volume, 'The Virtues of Plants & Herbs'.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "[scoffs] Peasants? People?"
Medium shot of Catherine casually holding the ancient book while pacing slowly before Juliana.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "That is why you were born in the wrong world. Women like me are meant to be admired. Women like you are meant to serve."
Tight close-up of Juliana's face, tilting her head with an insightful, knowing smirk.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "Then why are you so desperate to make me kneel?"
Catherine's smug expression freezes, her eyes widening in momentary shock and fury as the blow lands squarely.
Low-angle medium shot of Juliana, her voice ringing clearly through the subterranean chamber.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "If you were truly powerful, Catherine, you wouldn't need me to bow."
Close-up of Catherine completely losing control, her aristocratic facade shattering into sheer rage.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "Enough!"
Close-up of the red-hot poker pressing directly down into the delicate open pages of the botanical book.
Hiss of scorched parchment and curling white smoke rising as paper blackens under extreme heat.
Medium two-shot. Catherine holds the smoldering book right before Juliana's face.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "This pathetic book is the only thing you still have from your mother."
Extreme close-up of Juliana, her emotional composure breaking into pure grief and panic.
Tears spill rapidly down Juliana's cheeks as she reaches forward in vain, restrained by her heavy iron chains.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "[gasping] Give it back!"
Low-angle shot of Catherine grinning with sadistic triumph, looking down at Juliana's despair.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "There. Finally. Something still hurts you."
Close-up of Juliana screaming out in absolute anguish.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "No!"
Medium close-up of Catherine slowly driving the glowing branding tip into the spine of the open book, watching the embers consume the pages.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "One flame, and your mother's life's work becomes ash."
Low-angle medium shot. Catherine lowers the charred book and suddenly swings the glowing orange iron tip straight up toward Juliana's face.
Juliana recoils back against the hard dungeon wall, gasping for breath in raw terror as the searing iron stops inches from her eyes.

Extreme macro close-up of Juliana's wide, trembling eye. The brilliant orange ember of the hot poker reflects clearly in the center of her pupil, holding on the terrifying cliffhanger before an abrupt cut.
